changelog: Fix: v3.12.1's attempted fix didn't work — it tried to mark 2026_09_17_0002 'applied' in schema_migrations from inside 2026_09_17_0003, but migrate.php stops at the first failure in filename order and 0002 sorts before 0003, so 0002 kept failing its own guard and 0003 was never reached. Live stayed at 60 trades / 23W / 37L / -215.87 with the ZEC duplicate (trade 79 vs CSV row n=1) still present

Fix: 2026_09_17_0002 itself is now corrected in place. It was still status='failed' on live (not checksum-locked — only 'applied'/'baselined' migrations are, per CLAUDE.md §3A), so per migrate.php's own retry design this is the legitimate fix path, not a rewrite of history. Its post-verify guard previously checked an exact whole-challenge COUNT(*)=58 / win-loss split, which could never pass again once a legitimate trade (id 80, BNBUSDT 2026-09-14) was logged after the migration's snapshot. The guard is now scoped to source='import' — exactly the 58 rows this migration is responsible for — so it verifies its own work instead of the challenge's total row count on a given day. All of 0002's actual data statements (the 41 inserts, 17 updates) were already correct and are unchanged

Fix: 2026_09_17_0003 no longer writes to schema_migrations. Once 0002's corrected guard lets it pass, migrate.php's own recordMigration() marks it 'applied' with the real checksum of the edited file automatically — 0003's previous manual INSERT (built around a checksum of the pre-fix file) would have overwritten that with a stale value and permanently blocked every later migration behind a false checksum mismatch. 0003's actual fix (repair trade 79 to Bitfunded's figures for CSV row n=1, delete the duplicate 0002 inserted, +/-5 minute tolerance audit across the whole challenge) is unchanged

On the next migrate.php?mode=run, 0002 and 0003 both apply in normal filename order — no manual schema_migrations edit or file renaming needed. Expected end state unchanged from v3.12.1: 59 trades, 23W/36L, trade_variables unchanged at 135 (9 on trade 79)
